purpose: Verificação do planejamento de plataformas v1; estado/CI/corpus de L1 mantidos pelo implementador em trabalho concorrente.
scope: Documentação de arquitetura; não reexecuta nem aceita implementação.
command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json, re, subprocess
root=Path.cwd()
plan=(root/'docs/PLANO-DE-IMPLEMENTACAO.md').read_text()
state=(root/'docs/STATUS-IMPLEMENTACAO.md').read_text()
pat=r'M[01]-\d{2}(?:\.R\d+)?'
cards={}
bodies={}
for m in re.finditer(r'^### ('+pat+r') — ([^\n]+)\n(.*?)(?=^### M[01]-|^## |\Z)',plan,re.M|re.S):
    tid,title,body=m.groups()
    assert tid not in cards,tid
    dep=re.search(r'\*\*Depende de:\*\* (.*?)\. \*\*Frente:',body)
    assert dep and '**Entrega:**' in body and '**Aceite' in body,tid
    cards[tid]=re.findall(pat,dep.group(1))
    bodies[tid]=body
expected={f'M0-{i:02d}' for i in range(1,13)}|{f'M1-{i:02d}' for i in range(1,24)}|{'M0-01.R1','M0-02.R1','M0-02.R2'}
assert set(cards)==expected,set(cards)^expected
active=set()
def ancestors(k):
    assert k in cards and k not in active,k
    active.add(k); result=set(cards[k])
    for d in cards[k]: result |= ancestors(d)
    active.remove(k)
    return result
for k in cards: ancestors(k)
assert ancestors('M1-21')|{'M1-21'}==expected
assert cards['M0-02.R2']==['M0-02.R1']
assert 'M0-02.R2' in cards['M0-10']
for k in cards:
    if k.startswith('M1-') and k not in {'M1-01','M1-22'}:
        assert 'M1-22' in ancestors(k),k
rows=re.findall(r'^\| ('+pat+r') \|[^\n]*?\| (concluída|não iniciada|em andamento|bloqueada) \|',state,re.M)
assert len(rows)==38 and {t for t,_ in rows}==expected,rows
assert dict(rows)['M0-02.R2']!='concluída',rows
for k in ['M0-05','M0-06','M0-07','M0-08','M0-10','M1-19','M1-20']:
    assert 'Linux x86_64' in bodies[k] and 'macOS arm64' in bodies[k],k
assert 'x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu' in bodies['M1-20']
assert 'aarch64-apple-darwin' in bodies['M1-20']
for obsolete in ['três SOs','três sistemas','três alvos','cinco alvos','Cinco alvos','Linux x86_64/aarch64','macOS x86_64/aarch64']:
    assert obsolete not in plan,obsolete
paths=['README.md','IMPLEMENTADOR.md','docs/PLANO-DE-IMPLEMENTACAO.md','docs/RFC-0001-ARQUITETURA.md','docs/PLANO-DE-VALIDACAO.md','docs/PROVA-DE-DIFERENCIACAO.md','docs/contracts/m1.md','docs/relatorios/REVISAO-L0.md','docs/decisoes/PLATAFORMAS-V1.md']
for name in paths:
    p=root/name; content=p.read_text()
    assert len(re.findall(r'^```',content,re.M))%2==0,('fences',name)
    for link in re.findall(r'\]\(([^\s)]+)\)',content):
        if '://' in link or link.startswith('#'): continue
        q=link.split('#')[0]
        assert not q or (p.parent/q).exists(),('broken link',name,link)
    if name!='docs/relatorios/REVISAO-L0.md':
        assert 'Linux x86_64' in content and 'macOS arm64' in content,name
proof=(root/'docs/PROVA-DE-DIFERENCIACAO.md').read_text()
before=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','31961af:docs/PROVA-DE-DIFERENCIACAO.md'],text=True)
addition=next(p for p in proof.split('\n\n') if p.startswith('**Plataformas do v1:'))
assert proof.replace(addition+'\n\n','',1)==before,'competitive thresholds modified'
rfc=(root/'docs/RFC-0001-ARQUITETURA.md').read_text()
assert re.search(r'^\| 020 \|',rfc,re.M)
subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check','--',*paths],check=True)
print(json.dumps({'tasks_main':35,'followups':3,'dependencies':sum(map(len,cards.values())),'acyclic':True,'state_matches_cards':True,'R2_not_falsely_concluded':True,'all_feed_final_gate':True,'M1B_requires_G1':True,'platform_targets':['x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu','aarch64-apple-darwin'],'affected_native_acceptance_checked':7,'docs_checked':len(paths),'links_and_fences':'ok','competitive_protocol_unchanged_except_platform_scope':True,'git_diff_check':'passed','runtime_tests':'not rerun: architecture-only change; implementation verification remains in L1'},ensure_ascii=False))
